title: Predictor-vs-NCU Comparison Bundle (per-run)
description: One bundle per comparison run. Carries the headline geomean of per-cell relative errors between admitted predictor bundles and admitted NCU label cells joined on the contract-pinned 7-field key. The bundle records both the diagnostic comparable-cell denominator (cells matched on all 7 fields) and the headline-cell denominator (comparable cells with predictor result_kind in {scalar, bounded}); the geomean is computed only over headline cells. Two arms: 'admitted' carries the headline geomean and bootstrap CI; 'typed_unavailable' carries a typed_reason from the runner's enum (e.g., headline_geomean_admitted_cell_count_below_threshold). The schema mirrors cache_predictor.schema.json's discipline (additionalProperties: false; manifest_pairing_index analog; oneOf arm exclusivity; per-arm required clauses).

schema_version.description: Bundle schema major version. A deliberate schema bump must update both this constant and consumers in lockstep.

algorithm_version.description: Algorithm identifier for the comparison runner. Initial value is 'comparison_runner_v1'.

split_label.description: One of 'calibration', 'validation', 'holdout', or 'all'. The split selects which slugs participate.

comparison_run_pairing_index.description: Provenance binding for the comparison run. The runner pins these fields from the loaded contract; downstream readers can replay the comparison by reading the same contract version.

result_kind.description: Two arms. 'admitted' carries the headline geomean. 'typed_unavailable' carries a typed_reason.

top_level_admission_scope.description: Documents which admission path produced the verdict. 'target_arch=<arch>' means the runner was invoked with target_arch=<arch> (the documented Verified-live-<arch> baseline shape; relaxes the cross-arch floor check to that arch alone). 'cross_arch_require_both_arches' means the runner was invoked with target_arch=None under a contract whose coverage_gate.require_both_arches_for_cross_arch=true (every arch in arch_set must meet its live floor). 'cross_arch_any_arch' means target_arch=None AND require_both_arches_for_cross_arch=false (any arch meeting its floor admits). Without this field a bundle with result_kind='admitted' + per_arch.<other_arch>.meets_floor=false is ambiguous between Verified-live-<arch> and a cross-arch-any-arch admission off the lone-arch floor.

comparable_cells_per_arch.description: Diagnostic denominator: per-arch count of label cells that joined a predictor bundle on all 7 key fields. Includes typed_unavailable predictor bundles.

headline_cells_per_arch.description: Admission-floor denominator: per-arch count of comparable cells whose predictor result_kind is in {scalar, bounded}. The geomean is computed only over headline cells; the smoke-test floor is enforced against this count.

arches.description: Round-14 (AC-5.2): explicit list of arches present in the per-arch tally surfaces. Mirrors sorted(comparable_cells_per_arch.keys()). When target_arch is set, the list contains exactly [target_arch]; under cross-arch admission paths it contains every arch in contract.arch_set.

scalar_or_bounded_headline_cells_per_arc.description: Round-14 (AC-4.3): mirror of headline_cells_per_arch — cells that survived the typed-availability filter and have a usable comparison scalar (predictor result_kind in {scalar, bounded}). The plan's AC-4.3 threshold (>= 24 for sm_120) is checked against this canonical field rather than re-derived per call site.

full_cohort_geomean.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): geomean of per-cell relative errors over ALL included live scalar/bounded headline cells. Identical to the legacy `geomean` field on the admitted arm; exposed under the AC-5.3-named key so downstream readers can assert on the canonical AC-5.3 field. Emitted only on the admitted arm.

full_cohort_geomean_ci_low.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): lower bound of the bootstrap CI on the full-cohort geomean (contract pin: 2000 resamples, 0.95 confidence).

full_cohort_geomean_ci_high.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): upper bound of the bootstrap CI on the full-cohort geomean.

full_cohort_geomean_ci_half_width.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): half-width ((upper - lower) / 2) of the bootstrap CI on the full-cohort geomean.

holdout_geomean.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): geomean of per-cell relative errors over the included live scalar/bounded headline cells whose roster row has split == 'holdout'. The plan reserves 7 cells in the holdout split; typed-unavailable holdout cells are NOT silently substituted from calibration/validation. Emitted only on the admitted arm.

holdout_geomean_ci_low.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): lower bound of the bootstrap CI on the holdout geomean (contract pin: 2000 resamples, 0.95 confidence). Returns 0 when no holdout cells are in the included set.

holdout_geomean_ci_high.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): upper bound of the bootstrap CI on the holdout geomean.

holdout_geomean_ci_half_width.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): half-width ((upper - lower) / 2) of the bootstrap CI on the holdout geomean.

holdout_cell_count.description: Round-15 (AC-5.3): count of included live scalar/bounded cells whose roster row has split == 'holdout'. The plan's 7-cell holdout pool may have typed-unavailable cells excluded; this count records the actual headline-included holdout cells.

headline_floor_per_arch.description: Pinned per-arch smoke-test floor from the contract. Recorded for auditability of gate decisions.

allOf.description: Per-record cache_layer mirror arm L1TEX: when join_key.cache_layer is L1TEX, the per-record cache_layer MUST also be L1TEX. The mirror catches the case where a downstream consumer rewrites the per-record field without updating the join_key (or vice versa) so cross-surface drift is rejected at schema parse. Codex R58 code-review P2: the `then` clause now requires `cache_layer`; without `required` JSON Schema admits records that omit the field entirely, silently bypassing the mirror invariant.

Per-record cache_layer mirror arm L2: when join_key.cache_layer is L2, the per-record cache_layer MUST also be L2. The symmetric mirror to arm L1TEX. Codex R58 code-review P2: the `then` clause now requires `cache_layer` so a missing field can no longer silently pass the mirror invariant.

cache_layer.description: Closed-enum cache-layer classifier mirroring the predictor bundle's cache_layer field. Added as the 8th join-key element so per-layer bundles join independently against the same admitted-cell row (the layer-aware ground-truth resolution reads cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct for L1TEX vs cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct for L2).

Per-record cache-layer classifier mirroring the join_key.cache_layer field. Records for L1TEX-layer joins carry 'L1TEX'; records for L2-layer joins carry 'L2'. Legacy records without the field are treated as L2 by downstream consumers.

predicted_hit_rate.description: Canonical predicted hit rate. For 'scalar' arm this is the bundle's predicted_hit_rate. For 'bounded' arm this is the midpoint of [hit_rate_lower, hit_rate_upper] per the bounded-arm midpoint-canonical policy.

ground_truth_fraction.description: NCU label hit rate as a fraction in [0, 1]. The label cell carries percent in [0, 100]; the runner normalizes to fraction at point of use.

relative_error.description: Headline relative error per the contract formula |predicted - ground_truth| / max(ground_truth, epsilon). For the bounded arm this is the midpoint-derived error (canonical headline).

relative_error_lower_diagnostic.description: Diagnostic-only: the relative error computed from the bundle's hit_rate_lower. Required when predictor_result_kind == 'bounded'.

relative_error_upper_diagnostic.description: Diagnostic-only: the relative error computed from the bundle's hit_rate_upper. Required when predictor_result_kind == 'bounded'.

label_profiler_version.description: The label cell's profiler_version, which the runner cross-checks against the contract's pinned ncu_metric_version. Recorded for traceability.

evidence_kind.description: Optional classifier for the cell's evidence provenance, propagated from the joined label cell. Records emitted before the v3 admitted-cell schema migration may lack the field; the runner fills in 'synthetic' as a conservative default when absent so the live-only floor cannot count an unclassified cell.

predictor_design_coverage.description: Additive contract-pinned classifier mapping cohort cells to one of two buckets describing whether the Smith-Eklund LRU stack-distance baseline directly models the dominant cache behavior. Cells outside the headline cohort emit null. The runner sources the bucket from _PREDICTOR_DESIGN_COVERAGE_BY_CELL keyed on (slug, shape_point); per-bucket relative-error stats appear under per_arch_diagnostics.per_arch.<arch>.relative_error_stats_per_predictor_design_coverage.

grid_dim_alpha_source.description: Optional cross-arch extrapolation provenance for the gridDim density penalty alpha, propagated verbatim from the predictor bundle's top-level grid_dim_alpha_source field when present. METADATA ONLY: the runner does NOT gate cell admission or coverage-floor decisions on this value. Downstream auditors use the field to inspect whether a cell's predictor was run on the calibrated arch (sm_86_calibrated), extrapolated cross-arch under the legacy reuse policy (sm_86_extrapolated), decoupled on sm_120 with the penalty disabled (sm120_uncalibrated, emitted on the RTX 5060 Laptop GPU under the sm_120-only decoupled framework), or unrecognized device (uncalibrated). Records emitted from bundles that pre-date the field continue to validate (the field is OPTIONAL on the included-cell items).

diagnostic.description: Externally-emitted defect token. The first two values are members of comparison_runner._RUNNER_DEFECT_TOKENS (the runner-level vocabulary the bidirectional structural lockstep test asserts against); the third names an upstream/predictor-side exclusion that is intentionally NOT in the runner vocabulary (the predictor is the producer of the typed_unavailable bundle; the runner only records the exclusion). The diagnostic field is required on every excluded record so the on-disk artifact carries the failure-shape token externally rather than only as a private exception name.

reason.description: Short category tag for grouping in downstream reports. The diagnostic field carries the externally-visible token; this field categorizes by exclusion class. The layer-aware migration added two new reasons: comparison_runner_l1tex_label_mean_missing fires when a v4 admitted cell's L1 mean is absent and the L1 join is suppressed; local_label_admitted_l1_mean_migration_required fires when a v3 admitted cell record is rejected at parse time because it lacks the new l1tex_label_status field.

join_key.description: Partial or full key depending on what was available at exclusion time.

upstream_typed_reason.description: Required when reason == 'predictor_typed_unavailable'. Verbatim from the upstream predictor bundle's typed_reason field.

unmatched_field.description: Required when reason == 'join_key_unmatched' or 'comparison_contract_drift'. Names the join-key field whose drift caused the exclusion.

l1tex_label_status.description: Optional. Recorded on comparison_runner_l1tex_label_mean_missing exclusions to preserve the v4 admitted-cell record's L1 status verbatim so downstream consumers can audit why the L1 join was suppressed.

bundle_cache_layer.description: Optional. Recorded on cache_layer-driven comparison_contract_drift exclusions to preserve the offending bundle's declared cache_layer.

contract_cache_layers.description: Optional. Recorded on cache_layer-driven comparison_contract_drift exclusions to preserve the contract's cache_layers scope so the operator can see the gating decision.

geomean.description: Log-space geomean of relative_error across all included headline cells. Required when result_kind == 'admitted'.

geomean_ci_low.description: Bootstrap CI lower bound on the geomean. Required when result_kind == 'admitted'.

geomean_ci_high.description: Bootstrap CI upper bound on the geomean. Required when result_kind == 'admitted'.

typed_reason.description: Required when result_kind == 'typed_unavailable'. The runner-level typed-reason enum carries 8 values: the runner-specific 'headline_geomean_admitted_cell_count_below_threshold' (fired when the live coverage gate floor is unmet) plus the 7 headline-validity reasons that match `headline_validity_failed_reasons.items.enum`. The headline-validity reasons are admitted as top-level typed_reason values so the comparison-level fail-closed gate (added by the variance-precondition adjudication round's repair) can short-circuit the bundle to `typed_unavailable` whenever `headline_validity_failed_reasons` is non-empty; the top-level typed_reason mirrors the first failed reason in canonical `HEADLINE_VALIDITY_FAILED_REASONS_ALL` order. The 'calibration_loocv_p90_residual_exceeded' value also remains the value emitted by the LOOCV-specific short-circuit that runs after the comparison-level fail-closed gate. The 'calibration_variance_precondition_failed' value is the typed reason promoted from upstream predictor bundles whose variance-precondition gate fired (cross-cell prediction stddev below the documented 0.10 floor).

per_arch_diagnostics.description: Optional additive extension carrying per-arch summary statistics, exclusion-token tallies, and a coverage-gate verdict. Every arch in contract.arch_set appears as a key under per_arch with deterministic shape (zero-count arches use the no_cells statistics_status). The unattributed_excluded_reason_counts block tallies excluded records lacking a join_key.arch field. Existing bundles without this field continue to validate.

per_arch.description: Object whose keys are arch tokens (e.g. sm_86, sm_120) and whose values are per-arch diagnostic records. Arch tokens must match the ^sm_[0-9]+$ pattern; non-conforming keys are rejected.

unattributed_excluded_reason_counts.description: Tally of excluded records lacking a join_key.arch field. The three keys mirror the runner-side _EXCLUDED_DIAGNOSTIC_VALUES vocabulary; zero defaults are emitted on every key.

headline_validity_status.description: Additive optional field emitted by run_comparison when either headline_validity_inputs or calibration_evaluation_sidecar is supplied. 'valid' means no headline-validity guard fired; 'typed_unavailable' means the companion headline_validity_failed_reasons array is non-empty. Bundles emitted with neither input omit this field; downstream readers MUST treat its absence as 'unspecified' rather than 'valid'. Paired with headline_validity_failed_reasons via dependentRequired so a producer cannot emit one field without the other; the cardinality invariant enforced by the allOf branches below ties the status value to the array length (valid <-> empty; typed_unavailable <-> non-empty).

headline_validity_failed_reasons.description: Additive optional field listing every headline-validity typed reason that fired during the run. The enum admits SEVEN values: five sm_86-active reasons (the LOOCV reason plus the three earlier Tier-2 reasons plus the variance-precondition reason added by the recovery loop's variance-precondition adjudication round) plus two cross-arch reasons (unsupported_blackwell_memory_path, target_arch_unlabeled_extrapolation) added by the AC-T5.2 offline-schema closure. Production fire-path status: the five sm_86-active reasons fire from the existing per-input detection helpers + the calibration-evaluation sidecar + the variance-precondition gate (which promotes from upstream cache_predictor bundles whose typed_reason is `calibration_variance_precondition_failed`); `unsupported_blackwell_memory_path` fires when `run_comparison(...)` is invoked with the `unsupported_memory_path_sidecar` kwarg carrying producer entries with `path_resolved=true` and a memory-touching `excluded_op_class` (TMEM / CLUSTER_DSMEM / ASYNC_COPY / TMA / TEXTURE / SURFACE / ATOMIC); `target_arch_unlabeled_extrapolation` is the only enum member whose firing remains DEFERRED — it requires AC-T6 cross-arch zero-shot prediction artifacts (separate schema) and depends on live sm_100 evidence per the user's 2026-05-16 directive. Order inside the array is deterministic (sm_86-active reasons first matching comparison_runner.HEADLINE_VALIDITY_FAILED_REASONS_SM_86_ACTIVE; cross-arch reasons appended per HEADLINE_VALIDITY_FAILED_REASONS_CROSS_ARCH). The array captures ALL fired reasons (multi-failure invariant) even though the existing typed_reason field carries only the first gate that short-circuited. Removing any enum member breaks the AC-T7 schema-stability scan in tools/local_labels/test_headline_validity_guard_scanner.py.

publication_grade_floor_verdict.description: Per-arch publication-grade contract-floor gate verdict emitted by the headline runner. Always present in current bundles; mirrors ContractFloorGateVerdict in tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/publication_gate.py.

publication_grade_submission_verdict.description: Per-arch publication-grade submission-gate verdict emitted by the headline runner when a submission-track overlay is active. Mirrors SubmissionGateVerdict in tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/publication_gate.py.

publication_grade_tags.description: Top-level publication-grade tag bag. Emitted when an overlay is active and at least one tag (e.g., 'submission_gate_not_met') applies. Each element is a non-empty string identifier.

allOf.description: Admitted-arm cardinality invariant: the admitted arm forbids non-empty headline_validity_failed_reasons. Any bundle that emits with result_kind=admitted MUST have either an empty headline_validity_failed_reasons array OR omit the field entirely. The runner's comparison-level fail-closed gate enforces this on the producer side; this guard catches drift if a future producer regresses the gate. Paired with the negative jsonschema test test_schema_admitted_arm_with_nonempty_failed_reasons_rejected.

Dual-geomean enforcement on the sm_120-only admitted arm. When result_kind=='admitted' AND top_level_admission_scope=='target_arch=sm_120', the bundle MUST emit all 9 dual-geomean fields (full-cohort geomean + 3 CI fields; holdout geomean + 3 CI fields; holdout cell count). The plan's AC-5.3 negative test requires a bundle without holdout_geomean to be rejected; this conditional fires that rejection. Paired with the negative jsonschema tests test_schema_admitted_sm120_arm_requires_holdout_geomean and siblings.

oneOf.description: Admitted arm forbids typed_reason. Carries the headline geomean and bootstrap CI.
Typed-unavailable arm forbids the geomean and the dual-geomean fields. Carries only the typed_reason; arm-exclusivity for the 9 dual-geomean fields mirrors the legacy geomean's arm exclusivity.

per_arch_record.description: Per-arch diagnostic record. The relative_error_stats and signed_residual_stats shapes are determined by statistics_status via the oneOf branches that bind statistics_status with const so quartile fields can ONLY appear when statistics_status == 'quartile_emitted'. signed_residual is predicted_hit_rate - ground_truth_fraction so the values can be negative; only stdev is constrained to be non-negative. The bounded_arm_relative_error_stats block aggregates only over cells with predictor_result_kind == 'bounded' so it carries its own statistics_status (independent of the per-arch outer status, which is driven by the canonical relative_error sample over BOTH scalar and bounded cells).

n_comparable_cells.description: Per-arch count of included cells plus excluded cells with join_key.arch == arch and a diagnostic in the three-token enum.

n_headline_cells.description: Per-arch count of included cells with join_key.arch == arch (the relative_error sample).

relative_error_stats_l1tex.description: Per-arch relative-error stat block for the L1TEX cache layer. Aggregates only over included cells whose cache_layer == 'L1TEX'; the L2 block aggregates the symmetric L2 slice. The two blocks are emitted independently so the layer-aware comparison can report per-arch L1 and L2 diagnostics without merging into a layer-mixed geomean.

relative_error_stats_l2.description: Per-arch relative-error stat block for the L2 cache layer. See relative_error_stats_l1tex for the symmetric L1TEX block.

n_bounded_cells.description: Per-arch count of included cells with predictor_result_kind == 'bounded'.

relative_error_stats_per_predictor_desig.description: Additive per-bucket aggregation of relative-error stats over admitted cells in each predictor_design_coverage bucket. Each bucket entry carries {statistics_status, stats}; stats is null when the bucket has no cells (statistics_status == 'no_cells') and otherwise carries the same small-n shape as the per-arch outer relative_error_stats helper. The bucket vocabulary mirrors _PREDICTOR_DESIGN_COVERAGE_BY_CELL value enum.

per_arch_geomean_ci_block.description: Per-arch bootstrap CI on the log-space geomean of relative_error. Resampling unit is the cell; bootstrap_seed is recorded so byte-identical re-runs reproduce byte-identical CIs.

bounded_arm_arm_stats.description: One arm (lower or upper) of the bounded-arm relative-error stats. The stats shape is bound to statistics_status via the oneOf branches; quartile fields can only appear when statistics_status == 'quartile_emitted'. The values are absolute relative errors against hit_rate_lower (lower) or hit_rate_upper (upper) so all numeric fields are >= 0.
